title: Moving and Storage Allowance Added to Loss of Use, Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)
content:
Loss of use paid on an **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** claim carries a moving and storage allowance where the dwelling loss is severe.

**Allowance.** A moving and storage allowance is added: 2500 where the whole covered dwelling loss on the claim's latest FINAL adjuster report is at least 40 percent of the replacement cost value on the policy record, 1000 where it is at least 20 percent but below 40 percent, and nothing otherwise. Amounts are in US dollars.

The FINAL report read is the latest FINAL adjuster report of the claim; where the claim has no FINAL report, no allowance is added. The claim is the claim of the policy that carries the latest adjuster report, and every claim figure is read from that claim's own entries. Where two entries on a file share the date they are read by, or two policy records answer the same description, the one entered first is read.

Every share or period cut multiplies the loss of use counted; every amount deducted is then subtracted, never taking the figure below nothing; every allowance is then added; the loss-of-use limit then caps the result; payments already issued on the claim are subtracted after the cap; and every interest charge is added last.

| Whole covered dwelling loss on the latest FINAL report, percent of replacement cost value | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 40 or more | 2500 |
| 20 or more, below 40 | 1000 |
| below 20, or no FINAL report | nothing |

**Boundaries (hypothetical, replacement cost value 1000000).** A covered dwelling loss of 400000 is exactly 40 percent and earns 2500; 399999 earns 1000; 200000 earns 1000; 199999 earns nothing.
